name: the-compiler
description: Preserve the meaning of a request, turn it into concise instructions for the chosen AI or tool, and check the resulting work against the original goal. Includes clarification, compilation, evidence-based validation, and proposed reusable learning. Works with supplied context and available authorized tools. It does not run another model, guarantee outcomes, or automatically change files or external systems.

defaultPrompt: Help me turn this rough request into clear instructions for another AI.
Check this result against my original request and identify what is still unverified.
Explain what this completed run teaches us and whether any instruction should change.

publication.release_notes: Initial portable skills-only release with onboarding, bounded workflows, explicit evidence limits, and supplied-material fallbacks.
